7 Pinoy scholars to study space science in US
values.subheadline: SEVEN Filipino scholars are set to embark on a scholarship study in the United States after they were officially awarded grants under the Fulbright-PhilSA Program Award in Space Science, Technology, and Applications (SSTAP) by the Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) announced on Tuesday.

values.headline: Soldiers seized rebel guns in S. Kudarat
values.subheadline: GOVERNMENT troops recovered several high-powered firearms by during a clearing operation conducted by the 7th Infantry (Tapay) Battalion (7IB) in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat, the Philippine Army reported Tuesday.

values.headline: Phivolcs lowers Kanlaon alert level
values.subheadline: THE Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) announced on Tuesday evening it has lowered the alert status over Kanlaon Volcano from Level 3 (magmatic unrest) to Level 2 (moderate level of volcanic unrest).
